notes: Base nXp4004 is analog-only for program audio: DSP (32-bit SHARC) is standard, but Dante/CobraNet network-audio and AES3 digital I/O are factory-installed OPTIONS, not present on a stock unit, so they are omitted here. Each of the 4 analog inputs is a combo XLR/1/4" TRS jack wired in parallel with a Euroblock terminal (same physical port, multiple accepted connectors) — modeled as one xlr3 port per channel accepting trs-6.35 and euroblock. Speaker outputs: Ashly's manual and rear-panel diagrams for the 4-channel nX/nXe/nXp models show 2 Neutrik SpeakON (NL4) jacks, each carrying a pair of channels (1+/1-, 2+/2- and 3+/3-, 4+/4-); exact per-jack channel pairing is a well-documented Ashly nX4004/nXp4004 convention but the retail listings did not give an explicit rear-panel photo count, so this is a medium-confidence inference within an otherwise high-confidence, manufacturer-sourced spec set. Ethernet is 10/100 Mbit (spec sheets state "100MB Ethernet"), graded eth-100m. Dimensions 19in x 3.5in (2RU) x 16.84in, weight 32.4 lb, per SoundPro's retailer listing (soundpro.com), consistent with the 2RU chassis stated in Ashly's own manual. Serial data / fault / standby / preset / remote-level connectors are all 3.5mm Euroblock pluggable terminal blocks per Ashly's manual; no bandwidth grade applies to any of these control/logic/analog-audio/power connectors. Primary source: Ashly's own "nX, nXe, and nXp Power Amplifiers" Operating Manual (r10), hosted at ashly.com; cross-checked against Markertek's and Ashly's product pages (ashly.com/nxp-multi-mode/, ashly.com/amplifier-card/nxp4004/) and SoundPro's retailer listing for dimensions/weight.
